diagnosis: The clinical assistant tool lookup handler executes PatientMedicationHistoryTool by passing patientRecordId directly from tool inputs into the EHR repository. The endpoint does not verify whether the authenticated hospital staff member is assigned to the patient's care team or has an active clinical encounter. An unauthorized staff user can query prescription records, psychiatric medications, and chronic treatment histories of any patient across the hospital system.
exploit_request:
POST /api/copilot/tools/patient-medications HTTP/1.1

Authorization: Bearer staff_session_nurse_guest
